Maria Gonzalez: Hey team — just finished laptop setup. Got an email about the phishing simulation training that says it will run on my email and my personal phone may get SMS tests. Do I need to register my personal device? I thought company sims only go to company accounts.
Tariq Ahmad: Welcome Maria! :wave: The sims target your company email only (redwood.com). We don't send tests to personal numbers unless you opted into SMS for alerts. You shouldn't need to register your phone.
Maria Gonzalez: Phew, thanks. I had an automatic reply forwarded to personal email during onboarding and worried that might trigger something.
People Ops: We don't use forwarded personal addresses for tests. If you set an auto-forward rule from your work to personal, security recommends disabling it. See: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishsim-guidance
Maria Gonzalez: I do have Gmail forwarding enabled temporarily. Should I turn it off now?
Security Team: Yes please. If you can't disable it (e.g., corporate policy), file a ticket. Otherwise just disable forwarding from Gmail > Settings > Forwarding and POP/IMAP. Also don't click any suspicious links — open in incognito and report via the phishsim button.
Maria Gonzalez: Got it. I clicked a suspicious link earlier but didn't submit creds. I reported it via the button in the training email.
IT Support Bot: Ticket #4129 created for review of forwarded rules. We will reach out if any remediation is needed.
Mike Chen: FYI Maria — for full device policy compliance, ensure FileVault is on and that you enrolled in MDM. Check `sysinfo` in the Console app or run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment`.
Maria Gonzalez: I enrolled MDM during setup and enabled FileVault. Thanks for the checklist.
Eli Rivera: Tagging Security — can we confirm whether the reported click is treated as a simulated fail or flagged for review? @Security Team
Security Team: We'll review the event. Simulated clicks are recorded but we only escalate real credential submission or forwarded mail exposures. We'll DM Maria if anything else needed. :lock:
Maria Gonzalez: Appreciate the quick answers — feeling much more set. Thanks everyone! :smile:
People Ops: Welcome aboard again! Ping us if anything else comes up.
